WHY: Connect nationwide surplus inventory and clearance demand without misrepresenting availability.
VALUE: Transparent discounted inventory transactions and accountable intermediation.
OUTCOME: Verified listings and traceable, lawful purchase and fulfillment workflows.
OWNER: Every listing and order must identify its legal seller of record; payment and settlement amounts require authoritative ledger sources.
INVARIANT: Distinguish platform direct sales from third-party marketplace sales.
Never allow unapproved sellers to publish live listings.
Never mark an order paid without verified payment-provider evidence.
Never pay out twice for the same settlement obligation.
CONSTRAINT: Korean consumer, e-commerce and privacy requirements
production secrets excluded from Foundry ingestion
EVOLUTION: Extend seller operations, product catalog, fulfillment, dispute resolution and settlement without changing seller-of-record and ledger invariants.
